# Recording decisions

When you settle a question about a value in this repository, record the decision as a new file in `docs/decisions/`, with this front matter:

```
---
decision: <the adopted value, written exactly as in the configuration>
status: final
evidence: [<path of each file whose grounds decided it>]
---
<one paragraph: the values found, why each existed, and why the adopted one wins>
```
